shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real food, glass, ceramic and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
